descByPlatform.chatgpt: Environmental Editorial Portrait for Surgeon Corridor Portrait hospital-leadership series. Subject: female surgeon, 40s skin-warm #D9AE87, dark hair pulled back tight, surgical-teal #3F8080 scrub top and pants, matching surgical cap resting on shoulders as if just removed, clinical-white #F2F4F3 ID lanyard with chrome #B8BDC2 clip, stethoscope loose around neck, composed stance hands relaxed at sides, calm confident gaze straight to lens. Setting: long hospital corridor, corridor-pale-green #C8D7CC wall panels, chrome handrails, recessed LED troffers overhead receding into blurred depth. Composition: Rule of Thirds eyes 50% x 34% y, Eye-Level 0°, Medium Shot thigh-up, 4:5 editorial vertical, subject 56% of frame, corridor leading lines converge rear-center. Camera: Sony A7R V, 50mm G Master at f/2.5, 1/160s, ISO 500, handheld. Lighting: Overhead LED Key + Cool Fill — 2×4ft soft LED panel overhead 45° 1.4m daylight 5200K (key), 4×6ft silver-white reflector camera-left 1.2m (fill), 1×3ft strip rim camera-right behind 30° (shoulder rim), 4×4ft black flag camera-left to shape cheekbone. Skin: Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush. Capture One Cool-08 LUT grain 6 +0.1 EV. References: Platon Medical Heroes, Lynsey Addario Hospital, NEJM Cover. Exclude: plastic skin, color cast, cluttered corridor, hard shadows, logo distortion.
